_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take; alarm = hard ceiling. Re-baselined 2026-11-20 from the 1.0.0 checkup's measurements (.claude/docs/build-times.md "Status check, 2026-11-20"): a row whose why says "Measured" carries a target set from that series, a row that still says PROVISIONAL has no series yet. A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently.

forkBalance.why: Ported from the donor project: slow-tests --forks N warns when the suite span exceeds sum/N x (1 + maxExcessRatio) + minExcessSeconds; an even deal leaves a few seconds of straggler (the last class of one fork), an idle or unbalanced fork leaves tens of percent

changes.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median 7 s, 4-11 s; one checkout + one git diff. Target kept.

server-tests.why: PROVISIONAL, not measured by the checkup (the CI job summary prints it): the test task alone on 4 vCPU; leaves headroom of the server job for setup, compile, detekt and Kover

server.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median 4m44s, 4m35s-5m29s, 94 % of it the one Gradle check step; compile + detekt + tests + Kover on 4 vCPU. Target kept; the resolve-retry step added after this measurement will shift it (re-read at the next status check).

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median of the last 5 1m06s, 42-79 s; the settings-plugin audit (~28 s) plus the lockfile scan (~17 s) on a runner draw. Target 60 s -> 75 s (Adder WHY 3).

web.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median of the last 5 2m16s, 1m33s-3m02s; the shuffled-order coverage run is about half, npm ci a third. Target 90 s -> 150 s, alarm 180 s -> 240 s (Adder WHY 2).

e2e-static.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median 28 s, 23-63 s; npm ci (cached) + eslint + knip + tsc over the specs. Target kept.

images.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median of the last 5 3m03s, 2m50s-3m14s; the plain compose build is 2m14s of it, the Trivy scan 42 s. Target 150 s -> 195 s (Adder WHY 1).

k8s-static.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (6 master runs): median 13 s, 5-16 s; one checkout + a kubeconform download + validation of the small manifest set, twice (raw and rendered). Target kept.

e2e.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (3 nightly runs on master): median 7m46s (6m45s, 7m46s, 13m10s); the images build (~2 min), the Trivy scan, the stack start and Playwright. Target 7 min -> 8 min (Adder WHY 4).

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise. The steps are still PROVISIONAL: one nightly run's steps were read on 2026-11-20 (Run E2E 2m59s, Build images 1m52s, Install Playwright browser 37s, Start the stack 16s, Install e2e deps 4s), too few to set a target from.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: npm ci of the e2e workspace with the npm cache

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: install-deps (apt) with the browser cached; slower on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: a plain docker compose build of the app image, no layer cache: the same build as the ci.yml images job

e2e/Start the stack.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under `up --wait`; the app's healthcheck start_period is 30 s

e2e/Run E2E.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: the Playwright specs alone against a running stack

server-build.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (63 full runs of the series): median 86 s, last 30 median 92 s, 61-126 s on 18 cores; ./gradlew cleanTest check :server:installDist -Pforks=2 (scripts/gates.sh default). Target 180 s -> 150 s, alarm 360 s -> 300 s.

server-test.why: PROVISIONAL, no series: ./gradlew :server:test against one shared Postgres container (scripts/gates.sh does not record it separately)

web-gates.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (132 successful runs): median 18 s, last 30 median 23 s, 16-37 s; lint:api + check:api + lint + knip + test:coverage + build. Target 90 s -> 45 s, alarm 180 s -> 90 s (Adder WHY 5).

e2e-static.why: Measured 2026-11-20 (30 runs): median 2.3 s, 1.8-3.5 s; lint + knip + typecheck + check:scenarios. Target 30 s -> 10 s, alarm 60 s -> 30 s.

e2e-playwright.why: PROVISIONAL, no series: blackbox suite against a running compose stack (Playwright is not part of scripts/gates.sh)
